meta: Translate menus and signs with your phone camera when traveling abroad: point your camera, and AI translates and explains each dish.

muc.title: A menu you can't read
muc.text: Faced with a menu in a language you can't read? Point your camera at it and AI will translate and explain each dish.

muc.title: Straight and well lit
muc.text: Take a straight, well-lit photo and ask AI what each dish is made of, whether it's spicy, and the price in your currency.

muc.title: Don't rely on the translation alone
muc.text: If you're allergic to peanuts or seafood, don't rely on the translation alone. Ask AI to write a sentence in the local language to show the staff.

muc.title: Reading signs
muc.text: Same for signs at stations or parking lots: take a photo to find the exit, the timetable or what's not allowed.

muc.title: A package at home
muc.text: Photograph a package with foreign text at home, ask a chatbot to translate it, then compare with what you already know.
